北京.name: 北京

北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold at -1℃. Stay warm, protect from wind, and hydrate!

上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has sand, 14℃. Please wear a mask to protect your nose and mouth.
